stops.name: Pfahlbaumuseum Unteruhldingen

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Konstanz
stops.detail: The most important places on the lake were Bregenz (Celtic Brigantion) and present-day Constance.

stops.name: Abtei Reichenau
stops.detail: After their Christianization, the cultural importance of the region grew through the founding of the Bishopric of Constance (around 585) and the Reichenau Abbey (724).

days.title: Eastern Lake and Roman Heritage
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bregenz
stops.detail: Bregenz became the most important Roman town, which soon received Roman city rights and later became the seat of the prefect of the Lake Constance fleet.

stops.name: Lindau
stops.detail: The Romans were also in Lindau, but only settled the hills around Lindau there, as the shore was swampland.
